abstract: Few studies report on tissue morphology in recurrence of yolk sac tumor. The case of the recurrence of a yolk sac tumor as a spindle cell sarcoma of the abdominal wall is presented. A 27-year-old woman was referred to our hospital due to suspicion of an ovarian tumor. Right salpingo-oophorectomy, partial omentectomy, and extirpation of disseminated foci as fertility-preserving surgery was done since the intraoperative pathological diagnosis was yolk sac tumor. Final pathological examination showed a germ cell tumor of which yolk sac tumor formed the major component including a small area that appeared to be immature nerve tissue. Although residual tumor was not less than 1 cm, clinical complete remission was reached after the sixth course of BEP regimen. However, the recurrence of a yolk sac tumor as an unclassified spindle cell sarcoma of the abdominal wall was found about two years after the initial surgery. Thereafter, the patient expired due to progression of the intraperitoneal disseminated lesions. The mesenchyme-like component of the yolk sac tumor is characterized by spindle cells originating from epithelial elements, and is likely to give rise to a chemoresistant, diversely differentiated sarcoma. This report suggests that the sarcoma reported in the case here also arose when spindle cells of the mesenchyme-like component underwent sarcomatous change during or after chemotherapy, subsequently relapsed as a chemoresistant tumor, and metastasized.
abstract_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍の再発時の組織形態について報告した研究はほとんどない。卵黄嚢腫瘍が間葉様成分を伴う紡錘形細胞肉腫として再発した症例を提示する。27歳女性が卵巣腫瘍の疑いで当院に紹介された。術中病理診断で卵黄嚢腫瘍と判明したため、妊孕性温存手術として右卵管卵巣摘出術、部分大網切除術、播種巣の摘出を行った。最終病理検査では、卵黄嚢腫瘍が主成分である胚細胞腫瘍で、未熟な神経組織と思われる小領域を含んでいた。残存腫瘍は1cm以上あったが、BEP療法の第6クール後に臨床的完全寛解に至った。しかし、初回手術の約2年後に、未分類の紡錘形細胞肉腫として腹壁に卵黄嚢腫瘍の再発が認められた。その後、腹腔内播種病変の進行により患者は死亡した。卵黄嚢腫瘍の間葉様成分は上皮成分由来の紡錘形細胞を特徴とし、化学療法抵抗性で多様な分化を示す肉腫を生じやすいと考えられる。本報告は、本症例の肉腫も、化学療法中または化学療法後に間葉様成分の紡錘形細胞が肉腫様変化を起こし、その後化学療法抵抗性の腫瘍として再発し転移したことを示唆している。
